name: vt-feed-order

graded_by.test: owed by the E2 core plan
owed by the E2 vt plan

description: Output frames are applied in arrival order per session (D18), and a jump without a gap frame is refused, never spliced. Feed order rides kind-2 output frames, which a control sequence does not carry; this fixture records the control messages around them. After hello and the grid's open, the core feeds output frames through seq N — a re-feed at or below the worker's through_seq is ignored, and a gap frame moves through_seq to its seq and nothing else. When a later frame jumps without a gap frame the VT refuses it with error seq_jump and leaves the grid unchanged; the core then raises the stale flow with cause grid_lost (5.52; C2 decision 10), which is vt-grid-lost's fixture. The frames themselves are graded by the U4 worker (owed) and the core's feed by the U2 core (owed).
